name: Sarah Huckabee Sanders
stance: Backs the administration's AI agenda but opposes stripping states of power to regulate AI.

statements.text: Led 17 Republican governors in asking Senate Majority Leader Thune and Speaker Johnson to remove the 10-year AI moratorium from the One Big Beautiful Bill; the letter said people will be at risk until basic rules ensuring safety and fairness can go into effect.
AI is already deeply entrenched in American industry and society; people will be at risk until basic rules ensuring safety and fairness can go into effect.
